required_scenarios.description: Evaluate the exact candidate bytes without changing design or operation.
Set all declared PV resource availability to zero while preserving candidate sizing.
Move the grid outage from the final interval to the first interval; restore grid availability in the second interval to the candidate's declared import-energy cap.
Double every explicitly requested essential-service quantity, with overflow and unknown quantities rejected.
Require one kWh terminal reserve for battery architectures; mark no-battery architectures not applicable rather than silently changing their design.

claim_ceiling: Two-interval, integer-quantized, synthetic model only. This panel measures candidate sensitivity under declared perturbations, not long-duration resilience, calibrated site performance, or real cost/emissions.
